rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Multi-database server with OAuth 2.0 authentication and dynamic tool filtering, supporting SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and SQL Server through a unified adapter architecture. Features granular scope-based access control, tool group filtering to optimize token usage, and both stdio and HTTP transports with RFC-compliant OAuth resource server metadata. Designed for enterprise environments requiring secure database access with fine-grained permissions.
